## New plugins

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.new_plugins_by_year(data.new_plugins_by_year()))
```

## Maintenance

Every plugin released so far, by when it last shipped any version: in the six
months up to that month, six months to two years before, or not in two years.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.plugin_status(data.plugin_status()))
```

The same, as a share of all plugins:

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.plugin_status(data.plugin_status(), share=True))
```

## The plugin template

New plugins made from the [napari-plugin-template](https://github.com/napari/napari-plugin-template)
(cookiecutter until mid-2024, copier since), found from each plugin's repo and
PyPI description.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.template_usage_by_year(data.template_usage_by_year()))
```

## Python versions

The Python versions each plugin lists in its package classifiers, from its
latest release on PyPI. Plugins released in the last two years next to older
ones; plugins without classifiers are left out.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.python_support(data.python_support()))
```
